fact: The Namibia Statistics Agency states Namibia has no unified, standardised digital addressing system, no national addressing policy or legal framework, with practices fragmented across Local Authorities, and invites bids for a white paper on a National Digital Addressing System.
title: Request for Proposal for Consultancy Services to Develop a White Paper on the National Digital Addressing System for Namibia (SC/RP/NSA-04/2026)
